content: {"summary":"To tell if the feature store is refusing writes because snapshots are failing (MISCONF) or because memory is full (OOM), check Redis INFO fields and system logs: `INFO persistence` for `rdb_last_bgsave_status` (err → snapshot failure) and `INFO memory` for `used_memory` at `maxmemory` with `noeviction` (used_memory ≈ maxmemory → OOM). Also inspect the Redis journal for “fork: Cannot allocate memory” or “MISCONF” messages which indicate a snapshot‑fork failure. The combination of these checks tells which path is active.", "likely_cause":"Undetermined until the INFO and log checks are performed; the cause is either snapshot failure (MISCONF) or memory exhaustion (OOM) as indicated by the observed metrics.", "confidence":"medium","claims":[{"text":"rdb_last_bgsave_status:err indicates writes are refused due to snapshot failure (MISCONF)","evidence_ids":["RB-019#1"],"quote":"rdb_last_bgsave_status:err -> MISCONF path"},{"text":"used_memory at maxmemory with noeviction indicates writes are refused due to OOM (memory full)","evidence_ids":["RB-019#1"],"quote":"used_memory at maxmemory, noeviction -> OOM path"},{"text":"The Redis journal shows “fork: Cannot allocate memory” when a BGSAVE fork fails, causing MISCONF","evidence_ids":["RB-019#2"],"quote":"\"fork: Cannot allocate memory\" -> commit limit"},{"text":"stop-writes-on-bgsave-error=yes makes Redis refuse writes when snapshots fail","evidence_ids":["RB-019#0"],"quote":"stop-writes-on-bgsave-error yes. ... refuses writes (MISCONF)"}],"next_checks":["Run `redis-cli INFO persistence` and look for `rdb_last_bgsave_status` (err vs ok)","Run `redis-cli INFO memory` and compare `used_memory_human` to `maxmemory_human`","Check the Redis journal (`journalctl -u redis-server`) for lines containing \"fork: Cannot allocate memory\" or \"MISCONF\"","If `rdb_last_bgsave_status` is err, investigate snapshot/fork memory limits; if `used_memory` is at maxmemory, consider raising maxmemory or freeing keys"]}
